subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text :
stimulus: The teacher entered the classroom and said, "Dear students, are all of you present today?" "Except Rina, all are present, sir," said the captain. "She has not come because of her mother's illness." "Oh! What a sad news it is! May her mother come round soon," said the teacher. চ্যান্সেলর এসএসসি শটর্ সাজেশন্সের উত্তরমালা  98
guide_solution: The teacher entered the classroom and addressing them as dear students asked if all of them were present that day. The captain respectfully replied that all were present except Rina and added that she had not come because of her mother's illness. The teacher exclaimed with sorrow that it was a very sad news. He also prayed that her mother might come round soon.
